name: Cosco Air Conditioning & Refrigeration
old_description: Cosco has been providing the supplies and materials Hawaii's AC contractors have needed for 58 years. Visit one of our locations today to see how we can help you.
about:
Cosco Air Conditioning & Refrigeration was founded in 1961 in Kailua‑Kona, Hawaii, as a family‑owned supplier of air conditioning and refrigeration materials to local contractors. The business has remained under family ownership and operates multiple locations across the islands.

The company employs about 50 people and runs two main lines of business. Its core operation distributes HVAC and refrigeration supplies, including equipment from brands such as Daikin, for which it bills itself as Hawaii’s top dealer. A specialty division, Cosco Custom Coils, manufactures direct‑fit custom HVAC coils — condenser, evaporator, and chilled water coils — and converts microchannel designs to tube‑and‑fin construction using copper tubing.

Cosco primarily serves HVAC contractors throughout Hawaii, providing both stocked supplies and custom coil solutions for commercial and residential projects. Its customer base includes contractors who need OEM replacement coils, microchannel conversions, and copper tube‑and‑fin options tailored to specific job requirements.

The company emphasizes its long‑standing local presence and family ownership as key differentiators. It also promotes contractor training programs and maintains multiple branches to ensure quick access to parts and technical support for the Hawaiian market.
